Product classes

Computyme's "vendor group" on each product (479, 497, 992 …) is a class, not a vendor. The rules Computyme hard-codes against those numbers are written down here and stay locked. New classes are PIV2 extensions; products keep their Computyme class until product maintenance cuts over, so a new class can't be put on a product yet.
